blocks.text: We have extreme drought in the West that has created so many fires, neighborhoods are burning by the hundreds. All lakes, especially Lake Meade are at their lowest, serving over 80 million and the water level there is down to 1936 level and continues to drop. An important factor – soon there will be no water to turn the turbines that create electricity. Also there is no water for planting crops downstream which will create the largest food shortage the modern world has ever seen. Already many countries have starvation and people dying without food. So that you will understand the reason for writing this, a trip to your grocery store with inflation at 9% is higher now than in 40 years. – While I was writing this great floods were taking place in Tennessee & Kentucky, across the nation and also overseas and also historical high temperatures with people dying by the thousands. – I have a wonderful faith building letter from Brother Neal Frisby’s library. No better time than this to come forth.

“While the world is rocking to and fro and shaking in prophetic judgements and as the four elements are travailing in almost every nation bringing destruction the living God is also bringing forth the supernatural power of wonders and miracles everywhere among the people. The former and latter rain has come together and the restoration spirit is witnessing to all mankind. Jesus is doing the same miracles now as He did in the Old and New Testament.”

Now we reveal some of his miracles to build some faith in the New Testament. Matt. 8:5-13, And when Jesus was entered into Capernaum, there came unto him a centurion, beseeching him and saying, Lord, my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy, grievously tormented. And Jesus saith unto him, I will come and heal him. The centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof, but speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed. For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me, and I say to this man, Go, and he goeth, and to another, Come, and he cometh, and to my servant, Do this and he doeth it. When Jesus heard it, he marveled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel. And I say unto you, that many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven, But the children of the kingdom shall be cast out into outer darkness; there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth. And Jesus said unto the centurion, Go thy way; and as thou hast believed, so be it done unto thee. And his servant was healing in the selfsame hour.

Jesus showed us some real faith lessons concerning the centurion. He had compassion on his servant tormented with palsy. He said Lord, recognizing Jesus as Lord. He humbled himself knowing he was not worthy in righteousness, said he controlled a hundred men (Roman). He said, I say to one go and he goeth and to another come and he cometh showing he was in authority. He told Jesus you don’t have to move, just speak the word only and my servant will be healed. And the servant was rewarded. Jesus marveled and said no such faith was forever in Israel and he said to the centurion it shall be as thou ha s said and his servant was miraculously healed. Jesus also brought out a viewpoint some that he come to would be turned out (Jews) and the Gentile brought in. My what wisdom in lessons of faith. O’ church of the living God wake up! We have entered the period of speak the word only. Matt. 15:21-28, Then Jesus went thence, and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon. And behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts, and cried unto Him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, thou son of David, my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil. But he answered her not a word. And his disciples came and besought him, saying, Send her away; for she crieth after us. But he answered and said “I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.” Then came she and worshiped him, saying, Lord, help me. But he answered and said, it is not meet to take the children’s bread, and to cast it to dogs. And she said, Truth, Lord: yet the dogs eat of the crumbs, which fall from their master’s table. Then Jesus answered and said unto her, O woman, great is thy faith: be it unto thee even as thou wilt. And her daughter was made whole from that very hour. - Like the centurion here is another remarkable miracle concerning a Gentile Syrophenician woman. Amazing humility and courage changed her and her daughter’s life forever. The disciples tried to discourage her, then even Jesus, but it didn’t work. Pulling the best out of her Jesus said this is not for dogs (this was the wording the Jews used for these people) she called him Lord and then she called him master. Meaning she was willing to obey him in any way. She said yet the dogs eat of the crumbs, which fall from their master’s table. Jesus just couldn’t hold back. He said O, woman great is thy faith: be it unto thee even as thou wilt. Meaning her daughter would be healed and she could get anything else she wanted. She accepted it by faith. No matter what she just would not stop. O the creator pulled it right out of her! She was on a divine course of showing His disciples how faith worked and also His elect today! End quote. My, what a wonderful faith building letter!

This month we are releasing a New Book called “Book of Monthly Letters – Volume 4” Also a DVD “Prophetic Warning!” – As the age ends we do not want to let down our witnessing and winning of souls! It’s the only thing we can take with us before God! When the books are open let’s have a good report. Jesus will prosper and bless you. I will be praying daily for you
